jobs.location: New York City, US; Zurich, CH
jobs.description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Splice forms the public operating layer of Canton, including the Canton Coin application, the network’s tokenomics, fees, and incentives, the Canton Name Service (CNS), and network governance mechanisms. These components determine how the network functions economically, how participants are incentivized, and how change is introduced over time.
A successful candidate in this role will provide strong evidence of their ability to analyze ambiguous situations, make sound decisions with imperfect information, hold themselves accountable for making good judgement calls.
The role is not primarily focused on execution management or feature delivery, but rather on analysis and decision making. You will be expected to exercise independent judgment on matters that materially affect the network’s technical and economic trajectory, in collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders including node and infrastructure operators, application providers, and the Canton Foundation.
You will work as a close partner to the core engineering team that has built, and operated nodes in, Canton’s public network infrastructure over multiple years.

Responsibilities:

Own the Strategic Direction of Digital Asset’s Contributions to Splice

-

-
You’ll define, defend, and evolve the roadmap for Digital Asset’s contributions to Splice, while engaging with and responding to the interests of a wide range of stakeholders in the Splice contributor base and in the Canton Network as a whole. You are accountable for prioritization decisions and for the quality of reasoning behind them.

Make Hard Trade-Offs Explicit

-

-
Use structured analysis, modeling, and first-principles reasoning to evaluate protocol changes, incentive mechanisms, and governance proposals. You will be expected to articulate why certain paths are chosen—and others are not.

Operate at the Ecosystem Level

-

-
Align the interests of the Canton Foundation, application providers, validators, and internal stakeholders into a coherent product direction, even when incentives are misaligned.

Lead Through Expertise

-

-
Guide development across a distributed open-source contributor base. Influence is earned through clarity, technical credibility, and sound judgment.

Communicate for Decision-Makers

-

-
Produce clear, written artifacts that explain complex technical and economic issues to senior engineers, executives, external partners, and governance bodies.

Anticipate Long-Horizon Risk

-

-
Work with architects to identify long-horizon risks in distributed systems design and protocol economics, and ensure they are addressed before becoming constraints on network growth.

Adapt and Optimize

-

- Regularly adjust and reprioritize work to get the most useful results with minimal engineering effort. Regularly work with engineers to remove scope and adjust designs to focus on the essence of each problem and avoid unnecessary wor

What We're Looking For:

This role requires deep experience. Candidates should expect interviews that probe their reasoning and strategic decisions on similar projects.

-
10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of strategy for complex, long-lived platforms.

-
Demonstrated depth in distributed systems, Web3, or financial infrastructure, including BFT consensus, incentive mechanisms, and transaction lifecycles.

-
Proven effectiveness in open-source or multi-stakeholder environments where formal authority is limited.

-
Experience partnering with senior engineers and architects on foundational system design.

-
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Nice to Have:

-
Formal background in computer science or software engineering.

-
Direct experience with Daml, Canton, or comparable protocol-level systems.

-
Experience designing or evaluating incentive mechanisms or governance models.

Location:

Based in New York City or Zurich. Limited international travel (2–4 weeks per year).

This position may be based in New York or Zurich. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate's location and experience.
The range below may vary if based outside the New York tri-state area (New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut). As TradFi and DeFi converge, the demand for stable, regulatory-compliant and programmable units of value has never been higher. You will define and own the strategy for Digital Asset stablecoin & payments activation on the network, ensuring that stablecoin implementations and payment rails are not only technically superior but commercially dominant in contrast to other networks.

- Ensure that the scaling of stablecoin and payment use cases focuses on high-availability, security and low-latency settlement.

- Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset.

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3 years focused on stablecoins and payments .

- Proven track record of shipping products related to stablecoins use case intersecting with aspects of treasury management, cross-border payments, PoS provision or automated clearing houses (ACH)

- Deep understanding of the stablecoin and payments stack.

- Understanding of blockchain technology  is required and it would be great to have a familiarity with payments focussed layer 1/2 ecosystems

- While not a developer, you can confidently discuss application architecture, smart contract logic, and settlement workflows with engineers.

- Experience building for B2B or B2B2C environments where security, compliance and "five-nines" reliability are non-negotiable.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

At the core of all this is the Canton blockchain protocol and its implementation in the Canton   . Innovating on other layer 1 blockchain technologies in multiple ways, it offers real privacy, high scalability in a network of networks architecture, and the ability to run permissionless and regulated applications side by side with on-chain composability. Canton Network’s unique capabilities, both present and future, derive directly from the capabilities of the protocol. Many of the  feature requests and requirements from the ecosystem at large come down at a low level to enhancements to the protocol itself, often involving original R&D to come up with solutions that maintain the protocol’s privacy edge.

In this role you’ll be at the nexus between the core developers of the protocol and the many technical stakeholders - both Digital Asset internal and in the wider community - that are depending on the capabilities of the protocol and node. You’ll become one of the core experts in one of the most advanced blockchain protocols in existence, and help drive its ongoing development. You’ll engage with the developer community ranging across wallet/custory integrators, node operators, and core contributors both to inform them and  to understand their challenges and wishes for the network and protocol. And you’ll help translate your insights into an actionable roadmap and backlog and execute against it.

Responsibilities:

- Understand and track the requirements, problems, and wishes of the developer community dependent on the capabilities of the Canton ledger and validator node.

- Manage roadmap, backlog, and releases for the development team behind the Canton protocol and validator node.

- Become an expert on Canton’s functioning and capabilities and create informational materials ranging from documentation to marketing.

- Build relationships with other core development teams as well as the developer community at large and coordinate work between them and the developers of the Canton protocol and node.

- Support development work by clearly formulating problems and objectives, ideating with architects and engineers, and validating designs.

- Stay up to date with respect to the capabilities of other protocols, perform competitive analysis, and help marketing and sales turn your insights into digestible materials.

What We're Looking For:

- Deep expertise in blockchain technology and protocols.

- Market knowledge of blockchain privacy technologies.

- Evidence of being able to grasp, communicate, and write about highly complex technical topics.

- Experience with server-side/backend products, and related topics around deployment, monitoring, NFRs and integration.

- 5+ years experience across (technical) product management and related functions like program management and engineering management.

- Evidence of ability to coordinate multi-team and multi-stakeholder projects to successfully deliver results.

Canton Network’s growth is driven by a wide ecosystem of institutions and developers building on the network. Everything from crypto assets to regulated financial services, from data and oracle services to KYC and AML solutions for the network relies on Canton’s SDK: The smart contract language, blockchain APIs, integration components, and libraries. These toolchains, related sample code and architectural patterns, and the developer experience at large determine the speed at which the ecosystem can evolve. The network itself breaks new ground in targeting nimble web3 developers and large regulated institutions alike, with privacy as a first order concern. As such, the developer tools also need to cater to this wide stakeholder set and balance providing familiar, slick experiences with exposing and exploiting Canton’s unique capabilities - a design challenge spanning developer experience with cutting edge blockchain application architecture.

In this role you’ll be at the forefront of understanding the needs of developers building apps and services on Canton Network. You’ll engage with development teams across community and commercial partners to both inform them and understand their problems and wishes. You’ll be an expert application developer yourself and be intricately familiar with Canton’s application development tooling.  You’ll work with the SDK development team to prioritize problems, ideate and design solutions, and you’ll help translate your insights into an actionable roadmap and backlog and execute against it.

Responsibilities:

- Build relationships with builders across the ecosystem to understand their goals and obstacles.

- Become an expert on Canton application development and create materials ranging from documentation to developer marketing.

- Understand and track the requirements, problems, and wishes of the application developer and integrator community relying on Canton’s SDK.

- Manage roadmap, backlog, and releases for the development team behind Canton’s SDK.

- Support SDK development work by clearly formulating projects in terms of problems and objectives, ideating with architects and engineers, and validating designs.

- Stay up to date with the developer experiences provided by other network ecosystems and use that information to inform designs and priorities for Canton’s SDK.

- You care deeply about developer experience and have worked on developers facing products or technologies before.
